```{r}
### Clear workspace
rm(list=ls())
Sys.time()

### Set wd
setwd()
getwd()

### Load libraries
library(survival)

### Source functions
R.func.sources = list.files("R", full.names = TRUE)
sapply(R.func.sources, source)

###
### Read in HRs
###

### Direct effects
direct_HR_sbp <- exp(readRDS("data/p5/offsets_direct_lnHR_sbp.rds"))
direct_HR_nonhdl <- exp(readRDS("data/p5/offsets_direct_lnHR_nonhdl.rds"))
direct_HR_bmi <- exp(readRDS("data/p5/offsets_direct_lnHR_bmi.rds"))
direct_HR_smok_init <- exp(readRDS("data/p5/offsets_direct_lnHR_smok_init.rds"))
direct_HR_smok_cess <- exp(readRDS("data/p5/offsets_direct_lnHR_smok_cess.rds"))

### slopes (mfrs -> mfrs)
bmi_to_nonhdl <- readRDS("data/p5/slope_bmi_to_nondl.rds")
bmi_to_sbp <- readRDS("data/p5/slope_bmi_to_sbp.rds")
nonhdl_to_sbp <- readRDS("data/p5/slope_nonhdl_to_sbp.rds")
smok_cess_to_bmi <- readRDS("data/p5/slope_smok_cess_to_bmi.rds")
smok_cess_to_nonhdl <- readRDS("data/p5/slope_smok_cess_to_nonhdl.rds")
smok_cess_to_sbp <- readRDS("data/p5/slope_smok_cess_to_sbp.rds")
smok_init_to_bmi <- readRDS("data/p5/slope_smok_init_to_bmi.rds")
smok_init_to_nonhdl <- readRDS("data/p5/slope_smok_init_to_nonhdl.rds")
smok_init_to_sbp <- readRDS("data/p5/slope_smok_init_to_sbp.rds")

###
### Read in the redacted models
###
fit_pui <- readRDS(paste0("data/p5/small_fits_model_", "female", ".rds"))
means_pui <- readRDS(paste0("data/p5/small_means_model_", "female", ".rds"))
bhaz_pui <- readRDS(paste0("data/p5/small_bhaz_model_", "female", ".rds"))

### Read in fake patient file from rshiny app
pat <- readRDS("code/p5/p7_rshiny/data/fake_pat.rds") |> dplyr::mutate(offset_ah_timevar_lnHR = 0,
                                                                       offset_statins_timevar_lnHR = 0,
                                                                       offset_smoking_timevar_dummy1_lnHR = 0,
                                                                       offset_smoking_timevar_dummy2_lnHR = 0)

### Give them some elevated risk factors
pat$age <- 70
pat$bmi <- 30
pat$sbp <- 160
pat$nonhdl <- 5
pat$smoking[1] <- "Current"
pat$ethnicity[1] <- "black caribbean"
pat$IMD <- 10

### Reduce bhaz to baseline hazard at 10-years
bhaz_pui_y <- lapply(bhaz_pui, function(x){x[[10]]})

### Estimate predicted survival probability from initial risk estimation layer
pat$surv <- est_surv_offset_prototype3_redacted_mi(newdata = pat, 
                                                        fit_list = fit_pui, 
                                                        bhaz_list = bhaz_pui_y, 
                                                        offset_means_list = means_pui)
pat$risk_visit0 <- 1 - pat$surv

pat$risk_visit0

###
### The clinician engages in discussion
### Treatment options are:
### - start statins
### - start antihypertensives
### - stop smoking
### - through combination of diet and exercise, each of sbp, nonhdl or bmi could be reduced
###
### Lets present the risks from each

### Function to apply odds ratio to a risk score (no longer used)
# convert_risk_odds <- function(p, OR){
#   
#   ### Get odds of risk score
#   odds <- p/(1-p)
#   
#   ### Calculate new odds
#   new_odds <- odds*OR
#   
#   ### Convert back onto risk scale
#   new_risk <- new_odds/(1+new_odds)
#   
#   return(new_risk)
# }

### Function to apply hazard ratio to a risk score
convert_risk_HR <- function(p, HR){
  
  ### Get survival probability
  surv <- 1 - p
  
  ### Get survival probability onto the hazard scale by taking logarithm
  log_surv <- log(surv)
  
  ### Apply hazard ratios
  log_surv_adjusted <- log_surv*HR
  
  ### Calculate survival probability (note, we do not take the negative, 
  ### as we did not do this when converted back onto the hazard scale)
  new_surv <- exp(log_surv_adjusted)
  
  ### Convert back onto risk scale
  new_risk <- 1 - new_surv
  
  return(new_risk)
}

###
### Risk reduction from statins
###

### We expect an increase in BMI of 0.33
### We expect a reduction in nonhdl of 1.3268
### We expect a reduction in SBP of 2.62
statins_HR_bmi <- direct_HR_bmi^0.33
statins_HR_nonhdl <- direct_HR_nonhdl^-1.3268
statins_HR_sbp <- direct_HR_sbp^-2.62
statins_HR_bmi
statins_HR_nonhdl
statins_HR_sbp

### The combined odds ratio is
statins_HR_combined <- statins_HR_bmi*statins_HR_nonhdl*statins_HR_sbp
statins_HR_combined

### Reduce risk accordingly
pat$risk_visit0_statins <- convert_risk_HR(pat$risk_visit0, statins_HR_combined)

###
### Risk reduction from antihypertensives
###

### We hypothesis a possible reduction in 5, 10 or 15 mmHg

### The odds ratios are:
ah_HR_sbp5 <- direct_HR_sbp^-5
ah_HR_sbp10 <- direct_HR_sbp^-10
ah_HR_sbp15 <- direct_HR_sbp^-15

### Reduce risk accordingly
pat$risk_visit0_ah5 <- convert_risk_HR(pat$risk_visit0, ah_HR_sbp5)
pat$risk_visit0_ah10 <- convert_risk_HR(pat$risk_visit0, ah_HR_sbp10)
pat$risk_visit0_ah15 <- convert_risk_HR(pat$risk_visit0, ah_HR_sbp15)

###
### Risk reduction from smoking cessation
###

### We expect the individual to stop smoking
### We expect an increase in BMI of 0.66
### We expect an increase in nonhdl of 0.068
### We expect a reduction in SBP of 3.5
smok_cess_HR_smoking <- direct_HR_smok_cess
smok_cess_HR_bmi <- direct_HR_bmi^0.66
smok_cess_HR_nonhdl <- direct_HR_nonhdl^0.068
smok_cess_HR_sbp <- direct_HR_sbp^-3.5
smok_cess_HR_bmi
smok_cess_HR_nonhdl
smok_cess_HR_sbp

### The combined odds ratio is
smok_cess_HR_combined <- smok_cess_HR_smoking*smok_cess_HR_bmi*smok_cess_HR_nonhdl*smok_cess_HR_sbp
smok_cess_HR_combined

### Reduce risk accordingly
pat$risk_visit0_smok_cess <- convert_risk_HR(pat$risk_visit0, smok_cess_HR_combined)

###
### Risk reduction from weight loss
###

### We hypothesis a possible reduction of 5kg or 10kg

### Assuming a height of 165cm, a BMI of 30 would be 81.675

### A loss of 5kg would be a BMI of 76.675/1.65^2 = 28.16345
### This is a reduction of:
wl_5kg_change_in_bmi <- 28.16345 - 30
wl_5kg_change_in_bmi

### A loss of 10kg would be a BMI of 71.675/1.65^2 = 26.32691
### This is a reduction of:
wl_10kg_change_in_bmi <- 26.32691 - 30
wl_10kg_change_in_bmi

### According to the DAG, this will result in a drop in Non-HDL cholesterol:
wl_5kg_change_in_nonhdl <- wl_5kg_change_in_bmi*bmi_to_nonhdl
wl_5kg_change_in_nonhdl
wl_10kg_change_in_nonhdl <- wl_10kg_change_in_bmi*bmi_to_nonhdl
wl_10kg_change_in_nonhdl

### And a drop in sbp:
wl_5kg_change_in_sbp <- wl_5kg_change_in_bmi*bmi_to_sbp
wl_5kg_change_in_sbp
wl_10kg_change_in_sbp <- wl_10kg_change_in_bmi*bmi_to_sbp
wl_10kg_change_in_sbp

### The odds ratios are:

### BMI
wl_5kg_HR_bmi <- direct_HR_bmi^wl_5kg_change_in_bmi
wl_10kg_HR_bmi <- direct_HR_bmi^wl_10kg_change_in_bmi

### Non-HDL cholesterol
wl_5kg_HR_nonhdl <- direct_HR_nonhdl^wl_5kg_change_in_nonhdl
wl_10kg_HR_nonhdl <- direct_HR_nonhdl^wl_10kg_change_in_nonhdl

### SBP
wl_5kg_HR_sbp <- direct_HR_sbp^wl_5kg_change_in_sbp
wl_10kg_HR_sbp <- direct_HR_sbp^wl_10kg_change_in_sbp

### Overall is the product of these
wl_5kg_OR <- wl_5kg_HR_bmi*wl_5kg_HR_nonhdl*wl_5kg_HR_sbp
wl_10kg_OR <- wl_10kg_HR_bmi*wl_10kg_HR_nonhdl*wl_10kg_HR_sbp

### Reduce risk accordingly
pat$risk_visit0_wl5 <- convert_risk_HR(pat$risk_visit0, wl_5kg_OR)
pat$risk_visit0_wl10 <- convert_risk_HR(pat$risk_visit0, wl_10kg_OR)

###
### Risk reduction from reducing all through a combination
###
combination_HR_smoking <- direct_HR_smok_cess
combination_HR_bmi <- direct_HR_bmi^wl_5kg_change_in_bmi
combination_HR_nonhdl <- direct_HR_nonhdl^-2
combination_HR_sbp <- direct_HR_sbp^-10

### The combined odds ratio is
combination_HR_combined <- combination_HR_smoking*combination_HR_bmi*combination_HR_nonhdl*combination_HR_sbp
combination_HR_combined

### Reduce risk accordingly
pat$risk_visit0_combination <- convert_risk_HR(pat$risk_visit0, combination_HR_combined)

### 
### Present all in table
### 
visit0_table <- dplyr::select(pat, 
                              risk_visit0, 
                              risk_visit0_statins, 
                              risk_visit0_ah5, 
                              risk_visit0_ah10, 
                              risk_visit0_ah15, 
                              risk_visit0_smok_cess,
                              risk_visit0_wl5,
                              risk_visit0_wl10,
                              risk_visit0_combination)
knitr::kable(round(100*visit0_table, 2))

### A decision is made for smoking cessation, and to reassess at follow-up visit 1

#########################
### Follow-up visit 1 ###
#########################

###
### The individual has successfully cessated smoking and made some minor changes to diet, and plans to increase active tim
### Due to the diet changes they have reduced their BMI by 2 and reduced their nonhdl cholesterol by 2.5. 
### They struggled to increase their exercise levels and SBP has remained the same.
###

### First, we must re-estimate the baseline risk. The modifiable risk factors use the values from visit0, however we update
### the other risk factors.
pat_visit1 <- pat |>
  dplyr::mutate(age = age + 1)

### First we obtain risk if no intervention had been undertaken
pat_visit1$risk_nointervention <- 1 - est_surv_offset_prototype3_redacted_mi(newdata = pat_visit1, 
                                                                             fit_list = fit_pui, 
                                                                             bhaz_list = bhaz_pui_y, 
                                                                             offset_means_list = means_pui)

###
### Now we get a factual risk, based on the achieved levels in the modifiable risk factors
###

### Calculate the odds ratios based on the change in each of the modifiable risk factors
visit1_factual_HR_smoking <- direct_HR_smok_cess
visit1_factual_HR_bmi <- direct_HR_bmi^(28.16345 - 30)
visit1_factual_HR_nonhdl <- direct_HR_nonhdl^-2
visit1_factual_HR_sbp <- direct_HR_sbp^0

### Calculate combined OR
visit1_factual_HR_combined <- visit1_factual_HR_smoking*visit1_factual_HR_bmi*visit1_factual_HR_nonhdl*visit1_factual_HR_sbp

### Reduce risk accordingly
pat_visit1$risk_factual <- convert_risk_HR(pat_visit1$risk_nointervention, visit1_factual_HR_combined)

###
### Given the patient has successfully reduced nonhdl through lifestyle, but struggled with sbp, we suggest antihypertensives
###

### We again hypothesise a reduction of 5, 10, 15, and have these values already derived, and also do a reduction of 20, 
### so can apply them to the factual risk score
ah_HR_sbp20 <- direct_HR_sbp^-20

pat_visit1$risk_ah5 <- convert_risk_HR(pat_visit1$risk_factual, ah_HR_sbp5)
pat_visit1$risk_ah10 <- convert_risk_HR(pat_visit1$risk_factual, ah_HR_sbp10)
pat_visit1$risk_ah15 <- convert_risk_HR(pat_visit1$risk_factual, ah_HR_sbp15)
pat_visit1$risk_ah20 <- convert_risk_HR(pat_visit1$risk_factual, ah_HR_sbp20)

### 
### Present all in table
### 
visit1_table <- dplyr::select(pat_visit1, 
                              risk_nointervention,
                              risk_factual,
                              risk_ah5,
                              risk_ah10,
                              risk_ah15,
                              risk_ah20)
knitr::kable(round(100*visit1_table, 2))
```
